status: Shipping. MSRP raised from $3,999 to $4,699 in February 2026.
notes: CUDA deviceQuery reports 122,570 MiB (about 119.7 GiB) visible to the GPU under DGX OS; treated as 119.5 GB usable. Partner boxes (ASUS, Dell, Lenovo, Acer) exist but none was verifiably cheaper and in stock when checked.
estimate_note: MoE decode on CUDA reaches ~65% of the bandwidth ceiling here (Qwen3 30B-A3B: 89 tok/s measured vs 136 ceiling), against ~30% on Apple Silicon.
